### **I’m Ready To Get Started, What Do I Do?**

1. **Register** for your classes by clicking the “7 Workouts For $20” button in the upper right corner.

2. **Sign Up!** When you are ready to book your first class, head over to our [schedule](https://www.eastaustinathleticclub.com/schedule) or book in the app!

3. **Show Up**! We’re located at [**_4909 E. Cesar Chavez st. Suite C_**](https://www.google.com/maps/place/East+Austin+Athletic+Club/@30.251266,-97.7029235,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m5!3m4!1s0x8644b5a9114b7c9f:0xf6c9ad4ec0b3a555!8m2!3d30.251266!4d-97.7007295) **_._**

   - Be sure to arrive about 10 minutes before your first class, so you can explore The Club, meet your coach, and check in.
